source_revision_basis: retained native build source identity; raw reports bind the executable SHA-256

measurement_scope.median_rule: sort samples, midpoint of two central values rounded down
measurement_scope.stage_scope: grounding is initial core materialization; solving includes candidate search and interleaved source constraints; original_validation is nested detail, not additive with solving; null means unavailable
measurement_scope.rss_scope: separate memory samples only; their outer wall time includes the helper and is not a timed-process comparison
measurement_scope.sample_phase_order: qualification, warmup, timed, memory; native order rotates by case and round; report_position preserves actual schedule

verification.comparison: full typed JSON atom payloads resolved from incremental schema2 catalogs; shown atoms/terms and cost vectors; sorted with multiplicities; no semantic solver re-execution
